user.title: Weather Summary
user.description: Choose where the forecast comes from and which free LLM writes the short sentence. Open-Meteo needs no key; OpenWeatherMap and WeatherAPI.com use their free keys. For the LLM, 'OpenAI-compatible' covers Ollama (<host>:11434/v1), 'Home Assistant' uses the LLM already configured in HA, 'None' uses a built-in template.
